headline: Two DGFI members dismissed and jailed in extortion case
summary: Sergeant Al Mamun and Lance Corporal Md Nuruzzaman were sentenced to one year in prison following a court martial.
details: Two members of the Directorate General of Forces Intelligence (DGFI) have been dismissed from service and sentenced to one year in prison each following a court martial.
The convicts, Sergeant Al Mamun and Lance Corporal Md Nuruzzaman, were involved in an alleged extortion attempt and assault on a businessman in Dhaka's Mohammadpur on October 25.

caption:
Two DGFI members have been dismissed and sentenced to one year in prison for attempting to extort Tk 10 lakh from a businessman.

Two members of the Directorate General of Forces Intelligence (DGFI) have been dismissed from service and sentenced to one year in prison each following a court martial.

The convicts, Sergeant Al Mamun and Lance Corporal Md Nuruzzaman, were involved in an alleged extortion attempt and assault on a businessman in Dhaka's Mohammadpur on October 25.

The victim, motorcycle trader Mohammad Sharif, was allegedly confined in a flat in Chandrima Model Town and demanded to pay Tk 10 lakh.

Sharif had gone to the flat with an Ansar member to buy a motorcycle, but was instead confined and assaulted by four people.

The victim also handed over Tk 70,000 which he had brought for the purchase before being threatened again.

Sharif managed to escape by spotting a police patrol vehicle at a tea stall near Shishu Hospital in Shyamoli while being transported in a car.

Police arrested six people, including the two DGFI personnel, and seized the vehicle.

Following their arrest, the two DGFI members were handed over to the army and tried under military law.

headline_marked: Army soldier [[killed in gunfight with traffickers]] in Teknaf
headline: Army soldier killed in gunfight with traffickers in Teknaf
summary: Mohammad Titas Sheikh, 27, died during an anti-trafficking raid in the remote hills of Rangikhali, Cox's Bazar.
details: A soldier of the Bangladesh Army was killed during a gunfight between joint forces and suspected human traffickers in Teknaf, Cox's Bazar.
The clash occurred in the remote hills of Rangikhali, according to a statement released by the Inter Services Public Relations (ISPR) Directorate on Thursday night.
The deceased has been identified as Mohammad Titas Sheikh, 27, a soldier in the Bangladesh Army.
The operation was part of a larger effort by joint forces to crack down on human trafficking networks operating in the region.
caption:

The deceased has been identified as Mohammad Titas Sheikh, 27, a soldier in the Bangladesh Army.

The operation was part of a larger effort by joint forces to crack down on human trafficking networks operating in the region.
